name: IRIS
recent: 公司近期有多项重大诉讼公告，同时董事及大股东在闭市期前申报持股变动意向。2026财年首季业绩营收环比大增但同比下滑，净利同比大幅减少。
notable: 公司于2026年9月29日召开第一届常年股东大会，所有决议均以投票方式通过，包括批准每股0.5仙的终期单层股息。
公司于2026年9月1日、9月23日及10月8日分别发布重大诉讼公告。
董事Dato' Poh Yang Hong及Dr Poh Soon Sim等人在闭市期前申报有意交易公司证券。
risks: 公司有多项重大诉讼公告，具体内容未在摘要中披露。
董事及大股东在闭市期前申报有意交易公司证券，可能涉及股权变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为4097.4万令吉，环比增长93.5%，同比减少35.0%；净利为52.1万令吉，同比减少90.4%，净利率为1.3%。

recent_en: The company has made several material litigation announcements recently, while directors and a substantial shareholder have declared intentions to deal during the closed period. Q1 FY2026 revenue rose sharply QoQ but fell YoY, with net profit down significantly YoY.
notable_en: The company held its First Annual General Meeting on 29 September 2026; all resolutions were passed by poll, including approval of a final single-tier dividend of 0.5 sen per share.
The company issued material litigation announcements on 1 September, 23 September, and 8 October 2026.
Directors Dato' Poh Yang Hong and Dr Poh Soon Sim, among others, declared intentions to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
risks_en: The company has multiple material litigation announcements; details are not disclosed in the summary.
Directors and a substantial shareholder have declared intentions to deal in the company's securities during the closed period, which may involve changes in shareholdings.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 40.974 million, up 93.5% QoQ but down 35.0% YoY; net profit was MYR 0.521 million, down 90.4% YoY, with a net margin of 1.3%.
